data.title: 厄普西隆 · 晨起明镜的毫米级微调
data.description: 清晨阳光透入的私密更衣室。厄普西隆站在立地全身镜前，神情严肃紧绷如同面对生死决战，双手十指流动着细密的魔力，将贴身史莱姆薄膜以毫米为单位细致按压聚拢，誓要维持神话般的完美轮廓。
data.location: sunlit private boudoir dressing chamber with full-length ornate mirror
data.action: standing before a tall gold-framed standing mirror, carefully using fingertips to adjust the contours along her torso with glowing cyan magical threads
data.lighting: crisp early morning daylight slanting through lace sheer curtains
data.mood: intense meticulous perfectionism, hilarious secret vanity, breathless dedication
data.promptProse: Epsilon in a mint chemise stands before a boudoir mirror, with intense concentration using magic threads to adjust her slime body contours.
data.animaCaption: Epsilon diligently calibrating her slime body contours in front of her vanity mirror.
